purpose: A curated registry of public library catalogue discovery sources. Inclusion does not imply that a source exposes an API, permits automated retrieval, or provides a DDC field.

sources.name: SCERT Kerala Library
sources.classificationEvidence: The library's official page states that it uses Koha, MARC cataloguing and Dewey Decimal Classification.
sources.notes: High-priority pilot because both Koha and DDC use are explicitly documented. Locate and verify its public OPAC and any SRU/OAI-PMH/API endpoint before enabling automated requests.

sources.name: KILA Headquarters Library
sources.classificationEvidence: Official library pages identify Koha and a public OPAC; the classification source still needs to be confirmed from actual bibliographic records.
sources.notes: Useful Kerala pilot catalogue, especially for public administration, local governance and development subjects. Do not treat its call number as DDC until MARC 082 or Koha classification-source metadata confirms it.

sources.name: Kerala University Libraries
sources.classificationEvidence: The university's official annual report identifies Koha and its online catalogue. Classification source must be verified from records.
sources.notes: The catalogue covers the university library, campus library and departmental libraries. Check whether the catalogue exposes MARC records, SRU or another documented interface.

sources.name: Kerala State Central Library
sources.classificationEvidence: The public OPAC identifies itself as a Koha catalogue. DDC usage and machine-readable classification access remain unverified.
sources.notes: Public catalogue search is available without login. Verify classification field and permitted automated access before integration.

sources.name: Kerala Academic Library Network (KALNET)
sources.classificationEvidence: KSHEC describes KALNET as a unified discovery service across Kerala academic libraries. Individual source records may differ in classification practice.
sources.notes: Strategically important statewide discovery source. Investigate its public search endpoint and whether result records expose MARC 082, local call numbers and institution-level provenance.

sources.name: Centre for Management Development Knowledge Management Centre
sources.classificationEvidence: The official library page identifies Koha and says its OPAC is publicly accessible. DDC usage is not yet verified.
sources.notes: Find the linked OPAC URL and inspect public record fields before enabling automated retrieval.
